node: Hyperscaler AI capex and cloud AI demand
summary: Expanded the universe for the AI demand/capex conversion node beyond the seed hyperscalers into five US-listed companies with direct exposure to revenue-ready AI compute capacity: Oracle as a hyperscale cloud/AI infrastructure platform, CoreWeave as an AI-native neocloud, Digital Realty and Equinix as data-center asset/platform owners, and Dell as an AI server integration and deployment beneficiary. The common chokepoint lens is whether AI capex can be converted into usable, leased, revenue-producing compute capacity rather than remaining delayed by power, land, GPU/server availability, memory/component costs, permitting, or customer concentration.
